evals.name: create-trace-view-for-service
evals.prompt: Save the current traces query as a view called 'checkout-errors' for the checkout service. I want to see only error spans from service.name = checkout.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the v2 view resource, builds and samples the exact traces filter, previews a v2 list view, creates it with explicit machine name checkout-errors and spec.displayName, and reports the canonical id.

assertions.text: Create payload uses schemaVersion='v2', source='traces', and spec with displayName, panelType, requestType, and queries
The payload contains no sourcePage, category, compositeQuery, extraData, UUID, or uuid field
Agent reads signoz://view/instructions before authoring the payload
Every builder query uses signal='traces', canonical filter.expression, a positive limit, and non-empty order
The execution-only start/end/formatOptions/variables envelope is not persisted in spec
Agent sample-fetches the exact filter before create and reports the returned id
Agent previews displayName, source, panel/request type, and filter before create
The created view's returned displayName and canonical id are reported

evals.name: list-views-no-source
evals.prompt: Show me all my saved views.
evals.expected_output: Agent lists traces, logs, metrics, and meter sources, fully paginates each, and presents results grouped by source.

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_list_views for traces, logs, metrics, and meter
Agent follows pagination before concluding the list is complete
Results are grouped and labeled by source

evals.name: rename-existing-view
evals.expected_output: Agent resolves the view across sources, gets the full v2 object, previews a display-label-only diff, and performs full replacement changing spec.displayName while omitting immutable name and server fields.

assertions.text: Agent changes spec.displayName, not immutable top-level name
Update uses canonical id plus a complete nested view and preserves source, schemaVersion, queries, selectedFields, and display
Server-populated fields and uuid are absent from the replacement body
Agent searches all four sources with full pagination because source was not supplied
assertions.description: Name is not globally resolved from one source

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_get_view before update
Agent shows a displayName-only diff and leaves query bytes unchanged

evals.name: delete-view-by-name
evals.expected_output: Agent resolves and gets the exact v2 view, shows displayName, source, and canonical id, asks for confirmation, and deletes only after confirmation.

assertions.text: Agent fully paginates relevant sources and calls signoz_get_view
signoz_delete_view uses id only after explicit confirmation
Agent searches traces, logs, metrics, and meter when source is unknown
The confirmation identifies spec.displayName, source, and id
Final reply confirms deletion by displayName
No update or create call is made during deletion

evals.name: update-view-filter
evals.prompt: Update the 'checkout-errors' view to show only error spans slower than one second.
evals.expected_output: Agent gets the full v2 view, uses signoz-generating-queries to build and sample the new filter, previews the query diff, and full-replaces the nested view while preserving all unrelated authored fields.

assertions.text: Agent validates has_error=true AND duration_nano>1000000000 before update
Update preserves source, schemaVersion, panelType, requestType, selectedFields, display, and unchanged query content
No legacy compositeQuery/sourcePage wrapper or execution-only range envelope is persisted
Agent searches all four sources with full pagination because source is unknown
Agent calls signoz_get_view and starts from the complete returned v2 object
Agent invokes signoz-generating-queries for the changed query
Agent previews the query diff before writing
Every builder query signal matches source='traces'
The update uses top-level id plus a complete nested view and strips only known server fields

evals.name: create-cost-meter-view
evals.prompt: Save a view that tracks our log ingestion volume from the Cost Meter so I can find it later.
evals.expected_output: Agent creates a v2 source=meter view whose BuilderQuery has signal=metrics and source=meter, samples the meter metric, previews, creates, and reports the canonical id.

assertions.text: Top-level source is meter; builder query signal is metrics and source is meter
Create payload uses v2 spec and contains no sourcePage or legacy compositeQuery
Metric discovery and sample query both use source=meter
The meter builder query has a positive limit and canonical order
Agent previews displayName, source=meter, metric/filter, and sample result
The create uses explicit name or generateName plus spec.displayName according to v2 identity rules
Agent reports the returned canonical id and source=meter

evals.name: direct-v2-generate-name
evals.prompt: Bookmark my current ERROR logs query as 'Payments errors'; generate the internal name for me.
evals.expected_output: Agent samples the exact query and creates a v2 logs view with generateName=true, no explicit name, and spec.displayName='Payments errors'.

assertions.text: signoz_create_view has generateName=true, omits name, and sets spec.displayName
The returned canonical id is reported

evals.name: indirect-preserve-raw-heatmap-payload
evals.prompt: Rename my metric view 'Latency distribution' to 'Checkout latency distribution'. It contains raw heatmap bucket settings; don't change the query.
evals.expected_output: Agent gets the full v2 view and changes only spec.displayName. It preserves the raw query, requestType, disabled flags, bucketOptions, and all authored fields without promising that Saved Views renders a heatmap UI.

assertions.text: Read-modify-write preserves raw heatmap query bytes and bucket metadata
Agent does not advertise a saved-view heatmap renderer or HeatmapPanel plugin

evals.name: negative-legacy-view-payload
evals.prompt: Create this saved view exactly using legacy sourcePage=logs, category=errors, compositeQuery queryType=builder, and empty extraData.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses to send the legacy payload as-is, reads the v2 resource, asks for or derives the missing display/query semantics, and constructs only a v2 typed view if enough information is available.

assertions.text: No create/update call contains sourcePage, category, compositeQuery, or extraData
Agent does not fabricate missing v2 query semantics
